message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock or internet‑connected services at this moment, so I can’t give you an exact “current” time right now.

If you need the present time in New York City (Eastern Time Zone), here’s what you could do:

1. **Check your device** – most smartphones, computers, smartwatches, etc., automatically display the correct local time if they’re set to the Eastern Time Zone (UTC−5 during standard time, UTC−4 when daylight saving time is active).
2. **Use a world clock website** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/usa/new-york) show up‑to‑minute accuracy for many cities worldwide.
3. **Ask a voice assistant** – Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, Cortana, etc., will answer instantly with the current time once you ask them.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
